mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions and rising consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS is rising (month-over-month growth > 0.2%), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown across consumer and business sectors, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 218.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 218.0, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in both manufacturing output and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown phase.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the joint decline in INDPRO and RSAFS occurs but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 138000), strong employment conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 138000, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with elevated corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above 1000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
